title: Germantown Old Grand House
description:
Welcome to a stylish retreat with high ceilings, a modern kitchen, and updated bathrooms. Relax by the wood-burning fireplace or enjoy the private backyard with a hot tub, propane fire pit, and landscaped garden—perfect for relaxing under the stars.

Located within walking distance to downtown restaurants, attractions, and ballparks.

Note: A separate studio behind the home has its own entrance and is leased. The tenant does not have access to the garden or hot tub.
Owner/Broker LIC.336220 TN

The space
The property has 3 full bedrooms with an Additional Room upstairs before the Master Bedroom that can sleep one guest in a twin bed.

There is a separate studio in the back of the house with a full time tenant that has its own entrance and does not use the garden or hot tub.

Guest access
The house is available for 8 guests

Other things to note
Hot tub available to guests.

There are cameras on the outside for security, located:
Front porch, parking, back door kitchen
